full_description: Job Description Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met. Responsibilities Key Responsibilities System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: –Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools. –Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems. –Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members. –Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. –Implements performance and load testing. System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: –Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. –Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions. –Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability. System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: –Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures. –Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures. –Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: –Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. –Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. –Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: –Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation. –Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. –Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues. –Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. Compliance & Security: –Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. –Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security. –Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date Automation & Change Management: –Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure. –Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. Core Responsibilities Planning & Execution: –Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. –Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance Collaboration & Partnership: –Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices Continuous Learning: –Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.. Continuous Improvement: –Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. title: Senior Staff Azure Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
full_description: At Toku, we create bespoke cloud communications and customer engagement solutions that help enterprises deliver mission-critical customer experiences. Headquartered in Singapore, we combine strategic consulting, technology, regional infrastructure, connectivity and global reach to support enterprises across APAC and beyond. We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to take on the most senior individual-contributor role within our Infrastructure team. Working alongside the VP of Infrastructure, you will help set technical direction, architecture and engineering standards while remaining deeply involved in solving complex technical challenges. This is a cloud-agnostic role with a strong current emphasis on Microsoft Azure. You will play a leading role in establishing and maturing our Azure platform while also working across our existing AWS environment. You will drive modern cloud architecture, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, observability, CI/CD and automation, combining strong architectural judgement with hands-on engineering capability. What you will be doing Azure cloud architecture: Lead the design and evolution of secure, scalable and highly available Azure infrastructure, including Landing Zone architecture, governance, networking, identity, security guardrails and reusable infrastructure patterns. Multi-cloud architecture: Apply strong cloud architecture principles across Azure and AWS, establishing appropriate standards for scalability, resilience, security and operational effectiveness. AWS platform architecture: Continue to evolve our AWS estate across multi-account / AWS Organizations architecture, networking, IAM, security guardrails and core production services. Technical direction: Act as a senior technical authority for Infrastructure, owning key architectural decisions, establishing engineering standards and identifying opportunities to improve existing approaches. Infrastructure as Code: Own and improve Terraform-based infrastructure provisioning, developing reusable modules, consistent multi-environment patterns, testing and policy controls for reliable, repeatable deployment. Kubernetes: Architect, operate and improve production Kubernetes environments across Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Amazon EKS, ensuring they are scalable, resilient, secure and operationally robust. CI/CD & GitOps: Design and improve infrastructure delivery pipelines using technologies such as GitHub Actions and Jenkins, integrating IaC, version control, automated testing, policy enforcement and deployment automation. Observability: Build and improve monitoring and observability using technologies such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Cortex, Loki and Azure-native observability services, including dashboards, monitors, alerting and integrations. Automation & scripting: Use Python and automation to reduce repetitive operational work, integrate infrastructure tooling and improve reliability. Review automation code and provide technical direction on how infrastructure automation should be structured. Platform engineering: Build reusable infrastructure capabilities that enable engineering teams to provision, deploy and operate applications efficiently with less manual dependency on Infrastructure. Reliability & security: Engineer for high availability, disaster recovery and production resilience while embedding strong cloud security, IAM, networking, access controls and security guardrails into infrastructure design. Technical leadership: Mentor infrastructure engineers through hands-on collaboration, technical and design reviews and knowledge sharing, raising engineering capability while remaining an individual contributor. Cross-functional engineering: Work closely with Software Engineering, Security and other technical teams to understand requirements and design appropriate infrastructure solutions. We’d love to hear from you if you have Experience: Approximately 8–14 years of relevant cloud, infrastructure, DevOps or platform engineering experience, including significant hands-on responsibility for production cloud environments and experience operating at Staff, Senior Staff, Principal, Architect or equivalent technical level. Microsoft Azure: Strong hands-on Azure infrastructure architecture, implementation and operational experience. You should be comfortable designing and establishing Azure environments rather than only administering existing services. Azure Landing Zone, governance, networking, identity and security experience is particularly relevant. AWS: Good hands-on AWS architecture and production experience across services such as EC2, ECS/EKS, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, CloudFront and Route53. Multi-account / AWS Organizations experience would be valuable. You will advocate for automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and DevOps best practices, leveraging tools like Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Kubernetes (EKS), and CI/CD pipelines to enable scalable deployments and operational excellence. Strong expertise in system design, architecture, and scalability for large-scale storage solutions. Proficiency in at least one major backend programming language (Kotlin, Java, Go, Rust, or Python). Experience designing and implementing highly available, fault-tolerant, and cost-efficient storage architectures. Deep understanding of distributed systems, replication strategies, sharding, and caching. Knowledge of data security, encryption best practices, and compliance requirements (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA). Experience leading engineering teams, mentoring senior engineers, and driving technical roadmaps. Proficiency with observability tools, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting at scale. Core Requirements Expertise in Large-Scale Storage Systems Deep knowledge of AWS storage services (S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, Glacier) and their performance characteristics. Experience designing and optimizing object storage, block storage, and file storage solutions at scale. Strong understanding of storage durability, consistency models, replication, and erasure coding for fault tolerance. Experience implementing tiered storage solutions and cost-optimized data retention strategies. Distributed Systems & Scalability Deep understanding of distributed storage architectures, CAP theorem, and consistency models. Expertise in partitioning, sharding, and replication strategies for low-latency, high-throughput storage. Experience designing and implementing highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems using consensus algorithms (Raft, Paxos, Gossip Protocol). Hands-on experience with high-performance NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, Cassandra, RocksDB). High-Performance Backend Engineering Strong programming skills in Kotlin, Java, Go, Rust, or Python for backend storage development. Experience building event-driven, microservices-based architectures using gRPC, REST, or WebSockets. Expertise in data serialization formats (Parquet, Avro, ORC) for optimized storage access. Experience implementing data compression, deduplication, and indexing strategies to improve storage efficiency. Cloud-Native & Infrastructure Automation Strong hands-on experience with AWS Well-Architected Framework and cloud storage best practices. Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation. Experience with Kubernetes (EKS), serverless architectures (Lambda, Fargate), and containerized storage workloads. Expertise in CI/CD automation for storage services, leveraging GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, Jenkins, or ArgoCD. Performance Optimization & Observability Experience with benchmarking, profiling, and optimizing storage workloads. Proficiency in performance monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana) for storage systems. Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills for latency bottlenecks, memory leaks, and concurrency issues. Experience designing observability strategies (tracing, metrics, structured logging) for large-scale storage systems. Security, Compliance, and Data Protection Deep knowledge of data security, encryption at rest/in transit, and IAM policies in AWS. Experience implementing fine-grained access controls (IAM, KMS, STS, VPC Security Groups) for multi-tenant storage solutions. Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP) and best practices for secure data storage. Expertise in disaster recovery, backup strategies, and multi-region failover solutions. Leadership & Architectural Strategy Proven ability to design, document, and drive large-scale storage architectures from concept to production. Experience leading technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and engineering best practices. Strong ability to mentor senior and mid-level engineers, fostering growth in distributed storage expertise. Ability to influence technical roadmaps, long-term vision, and cost optimization strategies for backend storage.

full_description: Designation: Agentic AI Engineer – ERP Automation Department: Technology / Product Engineering Experience: 3–7 Years (flexible based on expertise) Location: Bangalore 1. Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Agentic AI Specialist who can transform an existing ERP application into an AI-enabled, intelligent business operations platform. The individual will be responsible for understanding existing application workflows, identifying opportunities for automation, and developing AI-powered agents that can independently perform tasks currently handled by human users. The primary focus will be on automating accounting and financial operations by enabling AI agents to read, understand, interpret, validate, and process financial documents and automatically perform the necessary accounting entries within the existing ERP system. The objective is to build an ERP platform where approximately 70% of routine operational and accounting activities can be automated through AI, with human intervention reserved for exceptions, approvals, and complex decisions. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Agentic AI Development Design, develop, and deploy autonomous AI agents capable of executing multi-step business workflows. Build intelligent agents that can understand instructions, make contextual decisions, execute tasks, and verify outcomes. Implement multi-agent architectures where specialized agents collaborate to complete accounting and operational processes. Develop AI agents that can interact with existing ERP modules through APIs and application interfaces. Enable agents to learn from historical transactions, accounting patterns, business rules, and user corrections. Implement human-in-the-loop mechanisms for approvals and exception handling. B. AI-Powered Accounting Automation Develop an intelligent accounting engine capable of: Reading and interpreting bills, invoices, receipts, bank statements, and other financial documents. Extracting relevant information, including vendor details, invoice dates, amounts, tax information, line items, and payment terms. Identifying the nature of each transaction and understanding its accounting implications. Automatically identifying the appropriate General Ledger (GL) accounts and chart of accounts. Determining debit and credit entries based on the nature of the transaction. Identifying applicable tax treatments and accounting classifications. Creating journal entries and posting transactions into the existing ERP. Matching bills with purchase orders, payments, and vendor records. Detecting duplicate invoices, incorrect amounts, missing information, and unusual transactions. Reconciling transactions and identifying discrepancies. Learning from accountant corrections and previously approved accounting entries to improve accuracy. C. Existing ERP Application Automation Study the existing ERP architecture, application workflows, database structure, and APIs. Identify repetitive manual activities across accounting, finance, operations, and administration. Convert existing manual workflows into AI-driven automated workflows. Integrate AI capabilities into existing ERP modules without disrupting current functionality. Build intelligent search, natural-language commands, automated reporting, and workflow orchestration. Enable users to interact with the ERP using conversational AI. Automate data entry, transaction processing, reconciliation, reporting, and routine follow-ups. D. AI Integration and Engineering Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent models. Work with AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent technologies. Build RAG-based systems to enable AI to retrieve information from ERP databases, accounting policies, historical transactions, and business documents. Develop document intelligence capabilities using OCR, document parsing, and vision models. Build secure API integrations and backend automation. Optimize AI model performance, response times, and inference costs. Implement logging, monitoring, traceability, and error recovery mechanisms. E. Testing, Accuracy and Governance Establish accuracy benchmarks for document extraction and accounting classifications. Ensure that every AI-generated accounting entry is traceable to its source document. Implement validation rules to prevent incorrect or duplicate postings. Establish approval workflows for high-value or unusual transactions. Maintain audit trails of AI decisions, modifications, and postings. Ensure data privacy, access controls, and financial data security. 3. Technical Skills Required Must-have skills: Strong experience in Python and backend development. Hands-on experience building AI agents and agentic workflows. Practical experience with LLMs and prompt engineering. Experience with OpenAI APIs, Anthropic, or similar AI platforms. Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks. Knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and application integrations. Experience with OCR, document intelligence, and structured data extraction. Knowledge of SQL and relational databases. Experience building production-ready AI applications. Good-to-have skills: Understanding of accounting workflows, double-entry bookkeeping, and General Ledger. Experience integrating AI with ERP, accounting, or financial applications. Experience with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, Zoho Books, or similar systems. Knowledge of vector databases and RAG architectures. Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Experience with workflow automation tools and event-driven architectures. Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹1,800,000.00 per year Benefits: Health insurance Provident Fund Work Location: In person
